comment: The default library's props (L4a of docs/design/core/plans/2026-10-21-default-drone-library-plan.md): which UIUC files feed each, the drone its hover rpm is computed for, and each file's URL and UTC retrieval date. The UIUC files themselves are never committed (ruling 3).

props.note: derived: the APC Thin Electric 10x5's coefficients as UIUC measured them, applied at 9.4 in (NASA's rotor), citing NASA p.15's agreement

derived: the APC Thin Electric 9x4.5's coefficients as UIUC measured them, applied at 9.6 in (NASA's rotor); the static point reads about 10% above the run's lowest-J points (UIUC's tunnel at its slowest); hover reads the static point (Physics, 2026-10-22)

measured (UIUC; three blades by UIUC's 3-Blade heading). The FPV's mass is an assumed estimate until L5's parts sum: re-run the tool if that sum changes the chosen run. Its run is below its hover (the comment gives the Reynolds ratio), and hover lies above the static file's top (6396 rpm), so the effect at hover is unmeasured, but expected to be small: the static C_T stays flat within +/-2.5% over the 4x rpm range below it (Physics, 2026-10-22)

drone.name: Crazyflie-class
drone.published_source: Bitcraze's 2015 thrust table, all four motors (wiki.bitcraze.io/misc:investigations:thrust): 29 g between 28.6 g at 17174 rpm and 32.8 g at 18179 rpm; Bitcraze's fit gives about 17230 (bitcraze.io/2015/02/measuring-propeller-rpm-part-3)

props.note: static only: C_T and C_Q held at their static values over J (compile_airframe's 0..1 table), so thrust is overstated in climb and forward flight; at J about 0.2 a small prop has lost about a quarter of its static C_T (Physics, 2026-10-22); isolated-prop C_T; Bitcraze's whole-craft table reads about 8% lower at hover rpm (Physics, 2026-10-22)

stand-in, derived and assumed: tri-blade tables: mit_5x4 (three-blade, 5 in), scaled to 6 in per Physics' rule. The mass is basic_quad_airframe()'s parts at its defaults, about 0.602 kg. Its run is below its hover (the comment gives the Reynolds ratio), and hover lies above the static file's top (6396 rpm), so the effect at hover is unmeasured, but expected to be small: the static C_T stays flat within +/-2.5% over the 4x rpm range below it (Physics, 2026-10-22)
